concerns.text: FR-007 requires iterative VIF pruning (remove highest-VIF feature while VIF > 5.0, retain ≥ 150 descriptors) and plan.md Summary step 4 specifies VIF pruning + L1 fallback. T105 instead cites a 'ratified Plan Override' and states 'do NOT remove features; feature count must be unchanged'. No such override exists in spec.md or plan.md, so FR-007's pruning requirement has NO covering task.

FR-005 requires bootstrapping the DATASET (sample size equal to full dataset) with re-derived top-SHAP rankings per resample. T107 'resamples the computed SHAP values ... no dataset re-training per the ratified Plan Override' — the unauthorized override again; the spec-mandated bootstrap-of-dataset analysis has no covering task.

FR-013/FR-001(c) require filtering features with |r| > 0.85 computed only on the training split before model training. No task implements this filter; T105's 'do NOT remove features' and the coverage table omit FR-013 entirely. Missing task.

SC-007 requires flexible-molecule detection reproducible across TWO independent heuristics (rotatable-bond ≥ 5 AND a torsional-flexibility score) with Jaccard ≥ 0.8. T101 implements only the rotatable-bond flag; no task implements the second heuristic or the Jaccard ≥ 0.8 check. Missing coverage.

concerns.location: tasks.md:coverage table vs spec.md:FR-010, FR-011, SC-008
concerns.text: FR-010/FR-011/SC-008 have no implementing task and are declared out of scope citing Constitution Principle VI. The plan documents this conflict, but spec.md (Status: Draft) still contains the requirements unamended, leaving a permanent spec↔tasks coverage gap; the spec must be revised or the omission formally ratified at spec level.

US-2 scenario 1 sets a concrete acceptance criterion (validation R² ≥ 0.10 exceeding the null baseline). T104's verification only checks that metrics are written to model_metrics.json; the R² ≥ 0.10 check is never verified or honestly reported anywhere. Acceptance scenario uncovered.
US-1 scenario 3 requires the descriptor matrix saved to disk within 15 minutes. No task records or verifies a preprocessing-stage runtime bound (T110 checks only the global ≤ 6 h budget).

concerns.location: tasks.md (all tasks) vs spec.md:FR-009, US-3 edge case
concerns.text: FR-009 requires flexible-molecule outliers to be logged 'for downstream error analysis' and the US-3 edge case says 'the error analysis highlights these outliers for separate inspection'. T101 only sets the flag; no task performs error analysis on the flexible-flagged subset.
